question: Q2 necessity: delete or bypass each op of this quarter-step (pass operand A, pass operand B, or zero) and recount whether the digest is still right
number: 7 of 8 ops are individually necessary on 350 random and adversarial batches (every deletion variant gives a wrong digest on the first batch). The exception under that test is the internal mask (op 507): removing it passes all 350 batches (random inputs never reach the lane limit). A hill climb then found message words [3515313895, 4199922139, 4268841014, 4157659510, 4261819250, 559413089, 2883805668, 812809495] whose pre-mask sum a+b is 16.097 units >= 16; with the mask removed the packed circuit gives a wrong digest in the neighbouring lane for that witness placed in lane 1, 3 and 5 (wrong lanes 2, 4, 6), and the shipped circuit is right in all three. So all 8 ops are necessary; the mask is necessary by an explicit witness.
notes: z3 on the same question (some add >= 2^36 with the mask removed) returned unknown after 122 s; the witness came from the numpy hill climb (3594 generations, population 32768, 150 s) and is checked on the real packed circuit.
held_fixed: Held fixed: the shipped 595-op circuit (research/blake3_r3/candidate_blake3/experiments/rho.py: 7 lanes x 36 bits, ops add/and/or/xor/shl/shr, constants folded) re-derived by our own tracer b3core.py (595 ops; equals the scalar 3-round digest on 300+ batches; scalar core equals verifier/blake3.py on 3 and 7 rounds and the official 7-round fixture). Single deletion of one op at a time; three replacement variants; 350 batches (300 random, 50 adversarial: all-ones, alternating, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000 words).
